complaint: Where is my order? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
response:
Here is the applicable policy and the next step you can take:

For a delayed order, open the tracking link in your dispatch email and check the latest carrier update. [shipping.md]

complaint: I want to return the shoes I bought last week. How do I get a refund?
response:
Here is the applicable policy and the next step you can take:

Unused items, including shoes, in their original packaging can be requested for return within 30 days of delivery. [refund.md]

Contact support with your order number and the item you want to return. [refund.md]

After an approved returned item is received and inspected, an eligible refund is sent to the original payment method within 5-10 business days. [refund.md]

complaint: I forgot my password and can't log in.
response:
Here is the applicable policy and the next step you can take:

On the sign-in page, select "Forgot password", enter the email address linked to your account, and follow the reset link sent by email. [account.md]

If the reset email does not arrive or the reset link has expired, request a new link. [account.md]

complaint: The blender I received is broken. Can I get a replacement?
response:
Here is the applicable policy and the next step you can take:

Stop using a damaged or defective product. Contact support within 7 days of delivery with your order number, a description of the problem, and photos of the item and packaging. [product.md]

A representative will review the evidence and, if the claim is approved, arrange a replacement subject to stock availability or discuss an eligible refund. [product.md]
